title: Come Back When You've Grown Up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, frog. This is your room from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This frog is going to be staying in my office for a short while. The reason being…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All animals of the academy are my potential familiars! If they get hurt, I need to look after them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: However, pets are not allowed in the dorms. We've been discussing what we should do.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm naming you Slurpy! Since I'll be taking care of you, you might as well have a name!
choice_data_list: (Well, I guess it's okay for a bit…)
(Well, I guess it's okay for a bit…)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I brought you some food, Slurpy! You better eat every bite, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: C'mon! Look at what a mess you've made!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, nooo! I don't wanna do that! I'm not in the mood today!
choice_data_list: But I've already put together today's schedule…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why you… Here's your punishment! Slurpy, spring into action!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, success! You should've seen the look on your face, Familiar! Nice job, Slurpy!

text_block_list.name: Slurpy
text_block_list.text: Ribbit, ribbit. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make you into… such a great fami…liar… Zzz… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Slurpy
text_block_list.text: Ribbit…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho spends time with the frog whenever she has the chance. Thanks to that, Slurpy's injury has been healing quite nicely.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hop, hop, hop!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nice job, Slurpy! You're hopping like a pro!
choice_data_list: You can hardly tell he was ever injured.
You can hardly tell he was ever injured.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That is fantastic. It looks like he can go back to his friends now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh…
choice_data_list: I'm sure his family is waiting for him.
I'm sure his family is waiting for him.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: N-no! No way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Um… I mean… It still looks like his leg is in pain, don't you think?! He isn't better yet! He can't go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I said no! He can't go until I say so!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ribbit! I found a bunch of worms in the rain! They're your favorite, right? Here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Ribbit, ribbit, ribbit…)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …What's that?
choice_data_list: It sounds like frogs croaking outside.
It sounds like frogs croaking outside.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Hmph! Whatever! Anyway, Slurpy, aren't you hungry? Eat your favorite food!

text_block_list.name: Slurpy
text_block_list.text: Ribbit… Ribbit, ribbit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait! What are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're my familiar! There's nothing you need outside!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It looks like he can go back to his friends now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure his family is waiting for him.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure his family is waiting for him.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Do you want to see your friends and family?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho grabs the cage somewhat roughly and releases the frog outside right away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Stupid Slurpy…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Anyone so weak as to sit around missing their family would never make it as my familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I have no problem living away from my family in a dorm! 'Cause I'm a grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And then there's Slurpy! Just a little baby that misses his family!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Come back when you're old enough to be without Mommy and Daddy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, we hear frogs start croaking outside as if responding to her.
choice_data_list: I'll pick up Slurpy's slack and help you out even more!
Come back when you've got some guts, Slurpy!
Come back when you've got some guts, Slurpy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, we hear frogs start croaking outside as if responding to her.
choice_data_list: I'll pick up Slurpy's slack and help you out even more!
Come back when you've got some guts, Slurpy!
Come back when you've got some guts, Slurpy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph… I'm holding you to that! You better work your butt off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You need to stay close and set a good example for the other familiars!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What're you acting all high and mighty for?! You've got a long way to go yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You better do your best to shape up into a worthy familiar by the time Slurpy gets back!
